stem:
Nisha puts one hand in warm water and the other in cool water. Then she puts both hands into the same basin of tap water.

Can she trust touch to say whether the tap water is hot or cold?

options.text: Yes. Touch still tells the true temperature of the tap water.
No. The two hands disagree, so she should measure.
Yes. The hand that was in warm water feels the true temperature.
No. The tap water has two temperatures at once.

teacher.key_rationale: After different prior temperatures, the two hands disagree. Touch is not enough. Measure.
